name: chart-history
description: XY chart of a recorded history. 'vs' plots one history against another instead of against step; 'begin'/'end'/'skip' window and thin the series.

common_usage_patterns.command: plot item create chart-history history 2 vs 1

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against MassFlow 3D 9.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: History to plot, by name or number.
keywords.name: history

keywords.description: Plot this history against another one instead of against step.
keywords.name: vs

keywords.description: First step/value of the history to plot.
keywords.name: begin

keywords.description: Last step/value of the history to plot.
keywords.name: end

keywords.description: Draw every Nth trace/marker to thin a dense field.
keywords.name: skip

keywords.description: Configure the x axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
keywords.name: axis-x

keywords.description: Configure the y axis (label, log, limits, exponent).
keywords.name: axis-y

keywords.description: Draw a glyph at each data point.
keywords.name: marks

keywords.description: Swap the x and y series.
keywords.name: swap

keywords.description: Set item transparency (0 opaque .. 100 fully transparent).
keywords.name: transparency
